findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V156 renders: three local pleat cycles per panel still read as broad flared faces with shallow irregular ridges; the repeated pleat rhythm and hem cadence are not distinct at product scale.
The crouch and sit renders still expose broad, angular upper-thigh shell edges at the front opening; the shell does not follow bent thigh contours closely enough to claim fit or adequate coverage.
Front, side, back and arm-cross views still show uneven pinched facets across the torso/waist and visible discontinuities where the jacket meets the skirt; V155 torso fairing remains insufficient.
The prone pose remains a rigid horizontal overlap of limbs and skirt panels without plausible drape; required pose evidence remains visually unacceptable.

nextAction: Keep the candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. V156 directly tested three pleat cycles on each of six sewn panels while holding the relief profile and hem fixed; all eleven current images were inspected and hash-bound, and the pleat rhythm remains unreadable. Do not repeat pleat-count changes alone. Next repair the panel/pose deformation path that creates broad skirt faces and the hard thigh shell cut edge; address torso/waist continuity separately, then rebuild and inspect all eleven views. Fit, UV, material, Shape Key, Unity, VRChat, packaging, and release remain unverified.
